title: FsStore: concurrent same-CID puts race on .tmp filename
description: Two concurrent put_raw calls for the same CID both write to {cid}.block.tmp. If Writer A writes then renames, Writer B's rename hits ENOENT and returns WriteFailed — even though the block is now correctly stored. In transit, a duplicate ingest from two peers arriving simultaneously would cause one pipeline worker to spuriously reject the article after the block is already on disk. Fix: use a per-call unique tmp name (e.g. tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in) or catch ENOENT on rename and check if block_path now exists, returning Ok(cid) in that case.
